messages:
maya: quick sync — need to lock the probebank selection protocol for the upcoming quant bakeoff (FP8 / INT8 / GPTQ / AWQ). constraints: ~10k probes max for cost, preserve edge-case coverage, keep anchors for regression detection. who can take ownership of the sampler logic?

owen: I can own the sampler. proposal: stratify by domain, length bucket, tokenization quirks, and a small adversarial slice. keep anchors at 3-5% of bank.

maya: @owen thanks. add a dedup step based on semantic embeddings (cos sim > 0.92) to avoid near-duplicates across buckets. also ensure we have negative controls (no-answer, hallucination triggers).

liam: for deduping, recommend using faiss clustering on sentence embeddings + keep one per cluster. cheap and works across languages.

sunita: question — how strict should the anchors be? i.e., exact-match vs paraphrase anchors?

dave: anchors should be strict core prompts (exact) + a small paraphrase set. e.g., 2 exact anchors per eval target and 1 paraphrase each. anchors are used for A/B drift checks.

owen: rough sampler pseudocode:
```
# pool: candidates (10M)
# steps:
# 1. filter by domain labels -> keep target domain ratio 60%
# 2. bucket by token_length [<20,20-64,64-256,256+] preserve distribution
# 3. embed + faiss cluster -> sample 1/k clusters per bucket
# 4. add anchors (3% of final) + negative controls (2%)
# 5. dedupe by embedding sim threshold 0.92
```

maya: that looks good. two follow-ups: (1) how do we define "domain labels" for unlabeled data? (2) what tooling will record provenance for each probe (model, quant config, seed)?

liam: domain labels can be heuristics: classifier over coarse labels (docs, conversational, code, math, instruction). it's fine if noisy — we just need rough coverage.

owen: provenance: each probe row will include: original_source_id, sampling_bucket, sampling_seed, sampled_at_ts, sampler_version. we should make sampler_version a git tag.

sunita: perf question — sampling + embedding cluster on 10M sounds heavy. can we do staged sampling: random prefilter 200k, then expensive embed+cluster?

dave: staged sampling is standard. random prefilter (200k) -> lightweight heuristics -> embed cluster. keeps costs low.

maya: deployment profile mapping: we need to mark each probe with target deployment profile tags: low-latency (short prompts), high-throughput (batchable), memory-heavy (long context), safety-critical. these tags will drive which quant configs to test per probe.

owen: agree. mapping ideas:
- low-latency -> prompt_len <40, no external tool calls
- high-throughput -> many short back-to-back gen sim
- memory-heavy -> >512 tokens or long code blocks
- safety-critical -> user-facing, PII-like patterns

liam: we should also include a small "stress" set of prompts designed to blow up KV-cache semantics (repeated contexts, long-range dependencies).

sunita: regarding eval metrics: for generation tasks use ROUGE/chrF where applicable + human eval for ambiguity + specialized checks for hallucination rate. include per-anchor delta tracking.

maya: can we standardize a CSV schema for probes? proposing fields: probe_id, text, domain_label, token_len, embedding_cluster_id, anchor_flag, negative_control_flag, tags (comma), provenance (sampler_version|seed|source_id).

owen: yep. I'll draft the schema and share a sample CSV. will include a small sampling tool config in the repo: `sampler/v2/proto.yaml`.

eval-bot: samplingsize-check — proposed final bank size 10,000, anchors 300, negatives 200, stress 200, remainder stratified. cost estimate ~ $1.2k per full-model pass (FP8 baseline).

maya: awesome. next steps: @owen take ownership, drop sampler PR by EOD Friday, include a small example pipeline and CSV schema. i'll coordinate with SRE for compute slots for cluster embedding.

liam: +1, will help validate clustering thresholds on a 200k prefilter sample.

sunita: will draft the human eval rubric for anchors and ambiguous cases.

maya: perfect. cc'ing here: @dave for anchor strategy signoff. any objections? :thumbsup: or :thumbsdown:

dave: :thumbsup: approved.

maya: thanks everyone — logging this thread to the quant-evals board. will post link to sampler PR once ready.
